independent_oracles: RC transfer: H(f)=1/(1+j*2*pi*f*R*C), with independently varied R, C and row temperatures.
Johnson-Nyquist input density: 4*k_B*(T_C+273.15)*R(T), k_B=1.380649e-23; output density is multiplied by |H|^2.
delivered: TEMP coordinates override resolved caller temperature; otherwise caller policy remains authoritative. Unresolved noise fallback heats both circuit equations and noise sources.
Control options retain only fields explicitly changed by executed commands; unrelated parameter-dependent authored options re-evaluate during row replay.
AcTable/NoiseTable control results retain complete FrequencyDataResult metadata. Explicit requests and declarative run share existing core table solvers.
